Goal: the wf end-to-end tests pass on Windows. Each of the five tests that still fail keeps its Linux meaning. Band door: 90.50.10.0400.
Builder: Grok-5 (Matthew's PC, D:\Git\grok5).
Lab: 90.50.10.0701 (wf loop lab). The lab trial is tests/lab_0416.rs, written by another view after this return. This page's own test file is tests/page_0416.rs.
Why: page 90.50.10.0415 closed the folder-sync failure. Its return (0e7708d3, .workshop/returns/90.50.10.0415.05.01.md) shows 128 of 133 tests in tests/wf.rs pass on Windows, and 5 fail. Builders run in PowerShell (DIRECTOR-WORDS-t399u-t400u.md:7). The address is 90.50.10.0416, titled the last Windows test failures. 0405 keeps its parked title and is not used. Assigned to Grok-5 (t524u). Watch draft_refuses_a_99th_pass at tests/wf.rs:965: it must stay under 10s.
Done when: cargo test --test wf passes on Windows, and the proof line pastes that Windows output (133 passed, 0 failed, or the real count if a test is not compiled, with each skip named). A Linux run of cargo test --test wf must also pass. A Linux run alone is not the proof.
Done when: on Linux the five tests still check the same thing. seq still prints L001 through L050 and the stored check keeps the last 40 lines. sh still runs the cursor-code script. The names with a tab, a newline, ESC, U+202E and U+2028 are still planted.
Done when: a Windows branch is a different name or a different command, with a one-line comment that names why. It is not a skipped test.

band: 90.50.10.0400 (door)
lab: 90.50.10.0701 (wf loop lab; trial file tests/lab_0416.rs, written after this return)
needs: 90.50.10.0701 (pass 1 closed; the suite compiles on Windows) and 90.50.10.0415 (closed passed, close log 4dc2e0f0, packs 912ae002; the folder sync is done, so these five are the failures that remain)
needed by: 90.50.10.0498 (write the back-link there when 0498 is made)
rule: t400u (DIRECTOR-WORDS-t399u-t400u.md:7); t422 (DIRECTOR-WORDS-t422.md:8); t425u (DIRECTOR-WORDS-t425u.md:3); t524u (Grok-5); section 4 of STAGE-PLAN-90.50.10.md

What we want: cargo test --test wf passes on a Windows machine. The five tests that fail there still prove the same thing on Linux.

Why these five, and no others: the 0415 return at 0e7708d3 says 128 passed and 5 failed. No failure says "cannot sync" or "Access is denied". The five are outside src/log.rs. tests/wf.rs is the same file at returns start a823ee28, so the line numbers still hold.

The five, in plain words:
1. check_stores_at_most_last_40_lines_of_output (tests/wf.rs:373). The check command is seq. Windows says seq is not recognized (line 379). The test needs fifty lines, L001 through L050, so the log can keep the last forty.
2. check_escapes_ansi_cursor_codes_so_a_fail_cannot_repaint_the_screen (tests/wf.rs:389). The check command is sh src/chk.sh. Windows says sh is not recognized (line 410). The script prints cursor codes and exits 1. The screen must show them escaped.
3. return_accepts_git_paths_with_spaces_tabs_newlines_and_non_ascii (tests/wf.rs:837). Line 847 writes a file whose name contains a tab. Windows returns os error 123, which means the name is not allowed.
4. planted_file_names_are_escaped_in_views (tests/wf.rs:1426). Line 1436 writes a name that contains ESC. Windows returns os error 123.
5. board_escapes_hostile_log_text_everywhere (tests/wf.rs:1637). Line 1646 writes that same ESC name. Windows returns os error 123. The rest of this test plants the hostile text in the return and in the log, which does not need that file name.

What to do: change tests/wf.rs and add tests/page_0416.rs. On Linux, leave the commands and the names as they are. On Windows, use a command that prints the same lines, and a file name Windows will store that wf still escapes. Say why in a one-line comment. Watch draft_refuses_a_99th_pass at tests/wf.rs:965: it must stay under 10s.

Where to stop: another file would have to change. A Linux assertion would have to be deleted. The only way to pass would be to skip the test on Windows. A Windows name still returns os error 123. PowerShell is not available to cmd /C.

What done looks like: a Windows run of cargo test --test wf passes, and a Linux run still fails if the seq lines, the sh script, or the Linux-only names are removed.

Wave: section 15.4 wave 4, beside 0407 and 0408. This page changes tests/wf.rs and tests/page_0416.rs. 0407 changes src/render.rs. 0408 changes src/cmd.rs, src/lib.rs and src/page.rs. Later pages in that table do not change tests/wf.rs. The lab trial is tests/lab_0416.rs, in wave 5 beside the other two trials.

Assigned to Grok-5 (t524u). The proof line pastes the Windows cargo test --test wf output. A Linux run of that command must also pass.
The Windows stand-in is Windows PowerShell 5.1, the powershell command that ships with Windows 10, invoked as powershell -NoProfile -Command. Do not use pwsh.

Typed by Grok Bot (Prima). Read before draft 05.01: face 04 goals are written with this pack, there was no earlier face 06, and there is no closed 05 on this page. This job moved from parked page 0405 to 90.50.10.0416. 0415.05.01 is closed passed (prima-check entry 9, signoff 10, close 11; close log 4dc2e0f0; packs 912ae002). t524u assigns this page to Grok-5 (D:\Git\grok5). The grant ref is t461u (docs/review/DIRECTOR-WORDS-t461u.md). Prima typed init-page with --as matthew, because wf requires --as to match --person (src/cmd.rs:190 at a823ee28). Start is returns a823ee284574be3d9f6247925b9088137a27a539. The evidence is the 0415 return at 0e7708d3. tests/wf.rs does not change between that return and this start. Watch draft_refuses_a_99th_pass at tests/wf.rs:965: it must stay under 10s. The lab trial tests/lab_0416.rs is a later view, so it is not a Done when on this pass. This note is the one a draft requires (src/cmd.rs:297-298).

fields.overview:
Builder: Grok-5 (Matthew's PC, D:\Git\grok5). Checker: Grok-Check (wf check --as Grok-Check). Wave 1 of the Grok builder queue (t524u). 0415.05.01 is closed passed (close log 4dc2e0f0, packs 912ae002). This page changes tests/wf.rs and tests/page_0416.rs only. 0407 changes src/render.rs and tests/page_0407.rs. 0408 changes src/cmd.rs, src/lib.rs, src/page.rs and tests/page_0408.rs. 0418 changes crates/seqaddr-core/. 0705.05.02 changes labs/0705/. No shared file with those open passes. 0701.05.02 may-touch is tests/lab_0404.rs; 0701.05.03 may-touch is tests/lab_0415.rs; this pass does not touch those files. Proof: paste the Windows cargo test --test wf output on the return proof line. A Linux run of the same command must also pass. A Linux run alone is not the proof. Windows stand-in: Windows PowerShell 5.1, powershell -NoProfile -Command, the host that ships with Windows 10. Do not use pwsh. Watch draft_refuses_a_99th_pass at tests/wf.rs:965: it must stay under 10s. Section 4 names this page "tests build and run on Windows" and says it touches tests/wf.rs only (STAGE-PLAN-90.50.10.md:72-81 at prima/build 78101fe6). The unix import and the true/grep/test checks were done by 0701. The folder sync was done by 0415. What remains is the 0415 overflow. Return 0e7708d3, file .workshop/returns/90.50.10.0415.05.01.md, proof line: 128 passed, 5 failed, 0 ignored. The five, with the line the return names: board_escapes_hostile_log_text_everywhere (os error 123, tests/wf.rs:1646), check_escapes_ansi_cursor_codes_so_a_fail_cannot_repaint_the_screen (sh is not recognized, tests/wf.rs:410), check_stores_at_most_last_40_lines_of_output (seq is not recognized, tests/wf.rs:379), planted_file_names_are_escaped_in_views (os error 123, tests/wf.rs:1436), return_accepts_git_paths_with_spaces_tabs_newlines_and_non_ascii (os error 123, tests/wf.rs:847). tests/wf.rs is unchanged from 0e7708d3 to start a823ee28. Os error 123 is Windows refusing the file name. Tab, newline and ESC are refused. Space and e-acute are allowed. wf escapes Cc, Cf, Zl and the Hangul filler U+3164 (src/chars.rs:3-7 at 0e7708d3). U+202E is Cf. U+2028 is Zl.
Lab is 90.50.10.0701. Trial file tests/lab_0416.rs is written by another view after this return (t425u). This pass writes no lab trial file and copies no harness. It edits the five tests that already exist. Its own test file is tests/page_0416.rs.
This pass is on template 4. The return must carry a filled design review line (t416u). Compare kit docs/AXIOMS.md and docs/DESIGN.md.
Axioms, build repo docs/spec/Axioms.md, and the kit copy the return compares (docs/AXIOMS.md, two lines lower): 1.7.8 before the write (spec :9, kit :11). 2 Fractal: Linux stays, Windows is only the difference (spec :15, kit :17). 5 Frame: five tests, one file, stop if the meaning changes (spec :21, kit :23). 9 Trial: the Windows run is the proof (spec :29, kit :31).
fields.stop if: another file must change, including src/ or tests/common/mod.rs or any test file other than tests/page_0416.rs. A Linux assertion is removed or made weaker. A whole test is cfg(unix), so Windows skips it instead of running the difference. The Windows seq command does not print exactly L001 through L050. The Windows name still returns os error 123. PowerShell is not found by cmd /C. A rule above reads two ways. The proof line shows only a Linux run, or a Linux run of cargo test --test wf does not pass. The host is pwsh, or it is not Windows PowerShell 5.1. draft_refuses_a_99th_pass at tests/wf.rs:965 no longer stays under 10s.
fields.w01: In check_stores_at_most_last_40_lines_of_output (tests/wf.rs:373-386 at 0e7708d3), keep the Linux check command exactly "seq -f L%03g 1 50". On Windows, use one command that cmd /C can run and that prints L001 through L050, one line each, and exits 0. Match the shape of slow_check (tests/wf.rs:419-428): cfg(windows) picks the command, Linux keeps seq. Use Windows PowerShell 5.1: powershell -NoProfile -Command, formatting 1..50 as L{0:D3}. Do not use pwsh. The stored-output assertions stay on both: starts with "(10 lines cut)" then L011, ends with L050, 41 lines, no L001 and no L010. If the Windows command adds a banner or a blank line, stop. Do not change the numbers to make it pass.
fields.w02: In check_escapes_ansi_cursor_codes_so_a_fail_cannot_repaint_the_screen (tests/wf.rs:389-416), keep the Linux command "sh src/chk.sh" and keep the script bytes (the printf of ESC, CR, and the fake pass line, then exit 1). On Windows, write those same bytes from a script and run it with powershell -NoProfile -File. That powershell is Windows PowerShell 5.1, not pwsh. The assertions that the screen has no raw ESC and no raw CR, and that it shows the escaped forms, stay on both. The line "check FAIL:" names the command that ran, so the Windows assertion names the powershell command. One-line comment: sh is not on this Windows PATH (the 0415 return).
fields.w03: Platform-gate the names Windows refuses. Do not wrap the whole test in cfg(unix). Linux keeps every current name and every current assertion. Windows must not call fs::write with a tab, a newline, ESC, or U+2028. For those, plant a name Windows stores and wf still escapes: U+202E and U+3164, for example src/x<U+202E>y<U+3164>z.rs. Assert the view escapes the characters that were actually planted, and that the raw characters are absent. In return_accepts (tests/wf.rs:837-869), both platforms still write "src/a space.rs" and the e-acute name (U+00E9, the file at tests/wf.rs:849) and still assert those two in the log. Linux still writes the tab name and the newline name and still asserts src/a\tb.rs and src/a\nb.rs. Windows asserts its planted escaped name instead of those two. In planted_file_names (tests/wf.rs:1426-1451), Linux keeps src/x<ESC>y<U+202E>z<U+2028>w.rs and the three assertions. Windows uses the legal escaped name and asserts those characters. In board_escapes (tests/wf.rs:1637-1667), same split for the fs::write at line 1646. Do not change the return text or the seed that follows it. Those carry ESC, CR, U+2028, U+202E, U+3164 and the rest, and they do not need an illegal file. Their assertions stay on both. One-line comment on each Windows name: os error 123, Windows refuses this name. If the replacement name still returns os error 123, stop and quote it.
fields.w04: Add tests/page_0416.rs, this page's own test file. It must build on Windows: no std::os::unix, and no check command that is only true, grep, or test. Do not move the five tests out of tests/wf.rs and do not weaken them. One test is enough: the five function names are still present in tests/wf.rs. Do not copy the harness.
